title: Lazar held at gunpoint at Indian Springs but never fired

tellings.quote: they bring him to Indian Springs they put a gun to his head

plain: In 1989, Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret site in the Nevada desert, was reportedly taken to Indian Springs in Nevada and had a gun put to his head, though he was never shot. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells Michels this second-hand, as it came through John Lear, a pilot who spread UFO claims in Las Vegas and knew Lazar; if true, it would show how hard someone tried to frighten Lazar into silence.
